tooltip.thaumicenergistics.vis_connector: Install in a wireless arcane terminal to recharge its wand through a Vis Relay Interface while connected to the network.
tooltip.thaumicenergistics.arcane_crafti: Perform arcane crafting from the ME network
tooltip.thaumicenergistics.essentia_leve: Emits redstone based on essentia levels in the network
tooltip.thaumicenergistics.vis_interface: Relays vis through the ME network to supply the ME Arcane Crafting Terminal and Arcane Assembler
tc.research_text.BASEENERGISTICS:
You have discovered a curious resonance between AE2's mechanical networks and Thaumaturgy.

The precision of AE devices seems capable of sensing and manipulating essentia, that mysterious form of matter.

High version materials are created by §b§l麦淇淋§r.

Aspects may take the form of essentia, the liquid obtained by distilling items, or vis, the magical energy stored in wands and consumed by arcane crafting. Essentia and vis are not interchangeable.
tc.research_text.FOCUS_AEWRENCH: By condensing the functionality of an AE wrench into a wand focus, you can manipulate AE network devices without switching tools.
tc.research_text.DIGISENTIA.stage.1: Though essentia is a mystical substance, you have discovered it can be processed using AE's digital technology. The key lies in two cores: a Diffusion Core to decompose essentia into digital signals, and a Coalescence Core to reassemble digital signals back into essentia.
tc.research_text.DIGISENTIA.stage.2: You have successfully crafted the Diffusion Core and Coalescence Core. They will serve as the foundation of your entire Thaumic Energistics system.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIASTORAGE:
ME Essentia Storage Cells are available in 1k, 4k, 16k, 64k, 256k, 1M, 4M, 16M, 64M, and 256M capacities.

1k, 4k, and 16k cells hold up to 12 essentia types; 64k holds 15, 256k holds 31, and 1M or larger holds 63. Each type uses 8 bytes of overhead and 1 essentia per remaining byte. Higher tiers use three components of the previous tier and the existing ME Essentia Storage Housing. Sneak-use an empty cell to recover its component, casing, and upgrade cards.
Combine an ME Terminal with an Arcane Worktable to make an ME Arcane Crafting Terminal and craft using the vis stored in its wand.

The ME Arcane Crafting Terminal consumes vis aspects stored in its wand for arcane crafting.

Ensure the wand holds enough of each required vis aspect. Essentia stored in the ME network cannot substitute for vis.
The Essentia Provider automatically extracts essentia from the ME network and supplies it to adjacent essentia containers. This is invaluable for devices that consume large amounts of essentia.
Place the Essentia Provider adjacent to an essentia container, and it will automatically replenish the container up to the configured level.
The Infusion Provider is an upgraded Essentia Provider. It can directly inject essentia from the ME network into an Infusion Altar, fully automating the infusion process.
Place the Infusion Provider beneath an Infusion Altar, and it will automatically supply the required essentia during infusion. No more manual jar placement!
tc.research_text.ARCANEASSEMBLER.stage.1: The Arcane Assembler is the arcane version of the ME Molecular Assembler. It can automatically execute arcane crafting recipes, perfectly merging magic with automation.
tc.research_text.ARCANEASSEMBLER.stage.2:
Connected to the ME network, the Arcane Assembler processes arcane crafting tasks automatically.

Bind it to a Vis Relay Interface using a memory card to replenish its internal vis buffer. Crafting consumes the required vis aspects; stored essentia cannot substitute for vis.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIAVIBRATIONCHAMBE: The Essentia Vibration Chamber converts essentia into AE power. Different essentia types provide different energy values — more complex essentia yields more energy. It offers a way to turn surplus essentia into usable power.
tc.research_text.KNOWLEDGEINSCRIBER: The Knowledge Inscriber converts Thaumaturgical research notes into Knowledge Cores that the AE network can recognize. It bridges the gap between arcane knowledge and digital storage.
tc.research_text.DISTILLATIONENCODER: The Distillation Encoder can automatically distill essentia from items and import it into the ME network. It combines the advantages of an essentia alembic with the AE network.
tc.research_text.VISINTERFACE:
The Vis Relay Interface relays vis through the ME network, supplying a remote vis source for the ME Arcane Crafting Terminal and Arcane Assembler.

Mount the interface on an AE cable facing a Vis Relay connected to an energized node. Copy its settings with a memory card, then use the card on the ME Arcane Crafting Terminal or Arcane Assembler to bind it.

It handles vis aspects, not the essentia obtained by distilling items.
tc.research_text.GOLEMWIFI: The Wireless Golem Backpack allows a golem to directly access items in the ME network. A golem equipped with this backpack acts as a mobile AE interface, enabling remote item access.
tc.research_text.CERTUS_DUPE: Using alchemical duplication, you can duplicate certus quartz crystals. This provides a renewable source of certus quartz for your AE network.
tc.research_text.ARCANEASSEMBLER:
An arcane counterpart to the Molecular Assembler for automated arcane crafting.

Bind it to a Vis Relay Interface using a memory card to replenish its internal vis buffer. It consumes vis aspects, not essentia as a substitute for vis.
tc.research_text.ARCANECRAFTINGTERMINAL:
Combine an ME Terminal with an Arcane Worktable to make an ME Arcane Crafting Terminal and craft using the vis stored in its wand.

The ME Arcane Crafting Terminal consumes vis aspects stored in its wand for arcane crafting.

Ensure the wand holds enough of each required vis aspect. Essentia stored in the ME network cannot substitute for vis.
tc.research_text.INFUSIONPROVIDER: Automatically supplies essentia from the ME network to an Infusion Altar.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIAPROVIDER: Automatically extracts essentia from the ME network and supplies adjacent containers.
tc.research_text.DIGISENTIA: Digitize essentia using Diffusion and Coalescence Cores for processing by the ME network.
thaumicenergistics.jei.transfer.ctrl_cli: Use Ctrl to craft missing items
thaumicenergistics.jade.monitor.title: Infusion Monitor
tc.research_text.INFUSIONMONITOR.stage.1: To observe is to command. You place the Thaumonomicon beside the altar, an observer peering into each pulse of the infusion — the stirring of aura, the opening of rifts, the first whisper of flux. Bound to an ME network, the observer truly opens its eyes.
tc.research_text.INFUSIONMONITOR.stage.2: The Infusion Monitor takes the Thaumonomicon as its key and the network as its sight. Place the tome and connect to the network, and it shall hover above the void, truthfully telling the risk of the ritual — and on right-click, it whispers its deeper warnings.
tooltip.thaumicenergistics.essentia_upgr: Insert into AE2 parts to grant them essentia capability
gui.thaumicenergistics.essentia_filter.h: No aspect selected - no filter (pass all); left-click toggles / right-click clears
%s aspect(s) selected; left-click toggles / right-click clears
tc.research_text.ESSENTIAPROVIDER.connec: The Wireless Essentia Receiver can be mounted on any surface. Use the Wireless Essentia Binding Tool to link it to an Essentia Provider, relaying essentia to alchemy towers and stills at a distance. Each provider serves up to eight receivers within thirty-two blocks; each additional receiver costs five extra AE/t. The receiver can also feed essentia back into the network, up to sixteen per transfer.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIAPROVIDER.tool.s: The Wireless Essentia Binding Tool creates and breaks wireless links: sneak-right-click an unlinked receiver to select it, then sneak-right-click an Essentia Provider to bind; sneak-right-click a linked receiver to disconnect. A normal right-click shows the connection coordinates of either device.
tooltip.thaumicenergistics.probability_a: Right-click a Brain of Probability to insert (max 4); shortens the longest turn
thaumicenergistics.brain_prob.brain_inse: Brain in a Jar inserted, bound to %s
thaumicenergistics.brain_prob.brain_pres: The Brain of Probability already holds a Brain in a Jar
thaumicenergistics.brain_prob.bound_to_o: This brain belongs to %s and cannot be taken
thaumicenergistics.brain_prob.ejected: Brain in a Jar and all accelerator cards ejected
thaumicenergistics.brain_prob.payout_det: Research gained this turn: %s (%s aspects, %s points)
tc.research_text.WIRELESSARCANECRAFTINGT:
Combine an ME Arcane Crafting Terminal, wireless receiver and dense energy cell for portable arcane crafting while connected to the network.

The wand and crafting ingredients remain inside the terminal when closed.

With a Vis Connector Card installed and a valid network connection, the terminal replenishes its wand through a Vis Relay Interface, including while carried in an inventory or Curios slot.

Press I by default to open an inventory or equipped arcane terminal. A universal terminal with the arcane attachment first switches to arcane mode. The key can be changed in Controls.
tc.research_text.ESSENTIAACCESSCARD:
Install one card in an ME Import, Export or Storage Bus, Interface or Pattern Provider.

Import respects filters; export requires an explicitly configured aspect; storage respects access and partition settings.

Interfaces maintain configured essentia stock, also accept essentia passively, and expose only their local stock. Essentia requests and new stock are limited to 256 per slot, including oversize interface blocks and parts. Existing overflow is returned to the network when space is available; otherwise it is retained.

Pattern providers deliver the inputs supplied by a crafting job and retain rejected amounts for retry.

One card per host.
tc.research_text.GACHABOX.stage.1: A probability device built around a Brain in a Jar: a two-block machine that draws cognitio from the ME network, rolling dice to credit random aspect pool points to the player who inserted the brain. Accelerator cards shorten each turn.
tc.research_text.GACHABOX.stage.2: Probability Accelerator Cards have no recipe yet and can be obtained from the creative tab; all output values are adjustable constants in the source.
message.thaumicenergistics.jei_processin: Cannot read all infusion items, essentia, and amounts; transfer was blocked.
This recipe exceeds the current processing pattern input or output slot limit.
The ME Essentia Terminal allows you to view all essentia stored in your ME network, just like browsing items.

You can insert and extract essentia directly from the terminal.

The ME Essentia Terminal can only view and manipulate essentia — it cannot access items or fluids.

It is purpose-built for essentia management.
